Shalom Nyaluge, a six-year-old girl from Malawi, joined us with her mother, Nelesi, at the President’s Residence in Jerusalem for a special event on Friday.

Shalom was born with a life-threatening hea condition that required specialized treatment. Despairing over their situation, her family learned about the Israeli humanitarian organization Save a Child’s Hea.

Over the last 30 years, Save a Child’s Hea has enabled more than 9,000 children from Africa, the Middle East, Asia, South America, and beyond to receive life-saving hea treatment free of charge.

Following her surgery in Israel in September, Shalom is now healthy and has been discharged, able to return home and continue her life. Her name means “peace” in Hebrew, and I could think of no better word for what this organization brings into the world.

It was an honor to host Save a Child’s Hea to celebrate this special 30-year milestone. You are an inspiration to us all.
